title: INT-001: Telemetry Schema Registry and Contract Tests
body: Define canonical telemetry schema S1a–S4, implement JSON Schema contract tests and CI enforcement. Deliverables: docs/planning/INT-001-telemetry-schema.md, tests/test_telemetry_contract.py, telemetry SDK integration. Acceptance: contract tests pass in CI, registry reviewed.

title: INT-002: Central Audit Service (append-only)
body: Implement central append-only Audit Service with API to append and query by correlation_id. Deliverables: core/audit_service (prod DB-backed), API endpoints POST /api/v1/audit/ and GET /api/v1/audit/?correlation_id=, retention policy. Acceptance: append and query work; modules able to write S4 audit entries.
